propositions: The workflow uses a refspec-first third-party checkout action that can land on a different commit than the requested patchset SHA if GERRIT_REFSPEC and GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION inputs disagree.
Run 33455923923 fetched patchset-1 refspec but was given patchset-2 revision, causing HEAD to diverge from the expected SHA before the guard detected the mismatch.
The workflow must validate that the fetched refspec resolves to the requested patchset SHA before any live Data Center operations execute.
The checkout step must fail with a clear error if the requested refspec cannot be fetched from either the GitHub mirror or Gerrit fallback, rather than checking out an inconsistent commit.
The workflow must leave HEAD explicitly on GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION in detached mode and verify this state before proceeding to setup/DC operations.
